tcs.test_item:
The system shall display 'All Songs' as the first item when a folder contains subfolders or subfolders and songs.

(First line item inside a folder holding subfolders and songs)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive is connected to the HU with this structure: the root holds two folders and two songs; each folder holds two subfolders and, in one case, two songs of its own; each subfolder holds two songs
2. USB is the active source on the HU
3. One of the root folders holds two songs of its own in addition to its subfolders
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the Folders category in the Categories Bank
4. Press the folder that holds both songs and subfolders and read the first line item displayed in the Browse List
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The folder browse list is displayed in the Browse List
4. The first line item displayed inside that folder is "All Songs"
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall generate a playback list including both songs and subfolders when 'All Songs' is selected.

(Track list composition after selecting All Songs inside a folder)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive is connected to the HU with this structure: the root holds two folders and two songs; each folder holds two subfolders and, in one case, two songs of its own; each subfolder holds two songs
2. USB is the active source on the HU
3. One of the root folders holds two songs of its own in addition to its subfolders
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the Folders category in the Categories Bank
4. Press the folder that holds both songs and subfolders and record its own songs and the songs held in its subfolders
5. Press "All Songs", then press the first song listed to start playback, then press "Tracks" and read the songs listed
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The folder browse list is displayed in the Browse List
4. The folder's own songs and the songs held in its subfolders are recorded
5. The track list contains both the folder's own songs and the songs held in its subfolders, as recorded in step 4
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)

tcs.test_item:
The system shall play individual songs first and then songs from subfolders when 'All Songs' is selected.

(Play order, not display order, inside a folder)
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. A USB drive is connected to the HU with this structure: the root holds two folders and two songs; each folder holds two subfolders and, in one case, two songs of its own; each subfolder holds two songs
2. USB is the active source on the HU
3. One of the root folders holds two songs of its own in addition to its subfolders
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Media" on Main Menu Bar to open the Media screen
2. Press "Browse" on the Tab Buttons to open the Browse Tab
3. Press the Folders category in the Categories Bank
4. Press the folder that holds both songs and subfolders and record its own songs and the songs held in its subfolders
5. Press "All Songs" and read the songs listed and their order
6. Press the first song listed to start playback, wait until it finishes and read the song shown as playing
tcs.expected_result:
1. The Media screen is displayed and USB is the active source
2. The Browse Tab is displayed in the Tab Area
3. The folder browse list is displayed in the Browse List
4. The folder's own songs and the songs held in its subfolders are recorded
5. The folder's own songs are listed before the songs held in its subfolders
6. The song shown as playing is the other song held directly in that folder, not a song from a subfolder
